prompts.name: icon_rise.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. A SINGLE game UI icon, hand drawn by a medieval ledger scribe with a broad quill. Subject: a filled upward triangle, with a slightly curved ascending left edge and confident upward apex, no stem. White #FFFFFF silhouette only, truly transparent background. Flat opaque white interior, no shading, no grey, no texture, no paper, no shadow, no decorative speckles. Gentle controlled handmade asymmetry, clean smooth edges, thick bold strokes and generous negative spaces. Readability at 16 pixels is essential. Centered in a square with 15 percent clear margin on every side. Similar visual weight to a 40px-wide filled triangle on a 64px canvas. No text, no labels, no extra icons. This is production icon artwork, not a sheet or mockup.
